title: Preserve matched checkpoint batch custody across administrative removal and reset
outcome: Administrative operations cannot discard exact original-checkpoint batch targets or measurement while retaining an operation that may later settle.
acceptance: Administrative session removal and project deletion retain or refuse to discard matched original-checkpoint batch inputs until their existing accounting owner has settled them; settings reset preserves the exact matched pending and independently owed custody without widening OFF admission.

Actual SQLite removal/reset witnesses use a nonempty strictly matched batch and preserve its exact targets, measurement and original identity through refused removal/reset and reload, then prove one exact receipt conversion with no duplicate binds or successor/enclosing-duty release.
The scoped fix and earlier in-scope Mediums receive independent review on the final complete input, with required exact-input checks and gate before landing.
